opportunities.title: Load sheet-metal parts into welding fixtures
opportunities.summary: Pick prepared sheet-metal parts and place them into a welding fixture. Figure 02 provides historical BMW pilot evidence; the retired model did not perform the weld.

reviewLinks.rationale: BMW confirms this exact Figure 02 loading task in its completed Spartanburg pilot.
limitations: Historical evidence: Figure 02 fleet retirement was announced in November 2025.
Loading supports the welding process; separate equipment welds and transfers the assembly.
The site still needs fixture integration, safeguarding and measured human recovery.

opportunities.title: Sequence automotive parts into delivery trolleys
opportunities.summary: Pick components from containers, sort them into a sequencing trolley and move it to a collection point. Figure 03 has a BMW demonstration; onward delivery uses other transport equipment.

reviewLinks.rationale: Figure and BMW describe the new Figure 03 sequencing and trolley-handoff workflow in June 2026.
limitations: Demonstration evidence; accepted output, intervention rates and staffing are not published.
The trolley’s final journey to the installation point is assigned to a tugger train or Smart Transport Robot.
Qualify each part family, cart rolling load and exception process.

opportunities.title: Lift and restack factory totes across pallet layers
opportunities.summary: Move compatible totes between low, middle and high stack positions. UBTECH names this industrial Walker S2 application; published production acceptance figures are still missing.

reviewLinks.rationale: UBTECH’s 2025 results name Walker S2 palletizing and depalletizing across multiple tote layers.
limitations: Manufacturer application claim, without a named-site cycle denominator or intervention rate.
Confirm tote load, handle geometry, stack stability and replenishment.

opportunities.title: Pick automotive components from flow racks
opportunities.summary: Grasp compatible parts from flow racks and place them into the required production set. Walker S2 has a manufacturer-reported sorting application, with task coverage still to validate.

reviewLinks.rationale: UBTECH explicitly identifies Walker S2 flow-rack sorting in automotive plants.
limitations: Manufacturer application claim; no published accepted-cycle or SKU-coverage denominator.
Confirm gripper configuration, occlusion handling and human replenishment.

opportunities.title: Check that automotive assembly kits contain every part
opportunities.summary: Inspect a prepared assembly kit for missing components and pass findings to the factory system. Walker S2 is named for this task; a person must define acceptance and exception handling.

reviewLinks.rationale: UBTECH specifically names SPS kit completeness inspection for industrial Walker S2.
limitations: No false-accept, false-reject or missed-part rates are published.
Validate lighting, occlusion and part variants; this does not establish final quality-release authority.
